title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 24–26). On the previous page Grothendieck takes a pointed curve (X,x), resp. an unpointed curve X, of type (g,ν), defined over a field K with algebraic closure K̄. He encodes it as a lifting (14), resp. (14'), of Γ_{K̄/K} → Γ_{Q̄/Q} through extensions M_{X,x}, resp. N_{X,x}, of Γ_Q. He conjectures that this data recovers (K, K̄, (X,x)), resp. (K, K̄, X). He then simplifies it to an outer Galois representation (15), resp. (15'): Γ_{K̄/K} → Aut_ext(π_{X,x}), i.e. Out(π̂_1).

This page plans to show how, up to small modifications, these representations are determined:
- by an open subgroup Γ = Γ_{K̄/K} of Γ_{Q̄/Q}, or an extension of it;
- with Γ_{Q̄/Q} ≅ Γ_{Q̃/Q} (two algebraic closures, identified up to inner automorphism);
- with Γ acting on a profinite group, here π̂_{g,ν}.

The key new notion is a 'discrétisation' (next page: 'discrétification') of the profinite surface group π̂_{g,ν}. It is the choice of a dense discrete subgroup isomorphic to the topological π_{g,ν} (surface group of genus g with ν punctures), up to conjugacy. A complex embedding K̄ → C gives one canonically: π_1^top(X(C)) inside its profinite completion π_1^et(X).

The page says it is enough, in addition, to give a set of discretizations of π̂_{X,x} that is stable under Γ. Such a set forms a torsor under M'_{g,ν} ⊂ Aut_ext(π̂_{g,ν}). Here M'_{g,ν} is the image of the Teichmüller modular group, i.e. the mapping class group Out⁺(π_{g,ν}), inside the profinite outer automorphism group. Two discretizations coming from complex embeddings differ by a mapping class.

The data therefore amount to torsors under M'_{g,ν}, 'better under M_{g,ν}' (the discrete modular group itself). In the unpointed case (5') they amount to torsors under N'_{g,ν}. M'_{g,ν} and N'_{g,ν} are quotients (images) of M_{g,ν}, resp. N_{g,ν}. In fact M → Out(π̂) is injective, which is why 'mieux sous M_{g,ν}' is harmless.

The next page formalizes this as a 'D-structure' on K̄: a choice of discretization of π_1(X) for every curve X/K̄ of type (g,ν). A 'special' D-structure is one induced by an embedding φ: K̄ → C. Γ = Aut_K(K̄) acts on D-structures by transport of structure. Special D-structures are conjugate under Γ, or perhaps only under an open subgroup.

The goal is to replace the arithmetic data of a curve over a finitely generated field by group-theoretic data: an open subgroup of Γ_Q, an outer action on π̂_{g,ν}, and a Γ-equivariant torsor of discrete structures. This serves the anabelian / Teichmüller-tower program of 1981–82, in which the discrete Teichmüller groups and Γ_Q both act on the profinite tower.
errors: The page is an unfinished sketch; 'à peu de choses près' signals unspecified ambiguities (inner automorphisms, finite-index issues). These are not resolved here.

The claim that a Γ-stable set of discretizations forms a torsor under M'_{g,ν} is not justified. The full set of discretizations is rather a homogeneous space Out(π̂)/Out(π), up to orientation, on which M acts by conjugation. A torsor under M only arises for the subset of discretizations coming from complex embeddings, i.e. those related by mapping classes. The text is ambiguous here.

For K of finite type over Q (as on the next page), the image of Γ_K in Γ_Q is open, but Γ_K itself is not a subgroup of Γ_Q. Hence 'ouvert (ou ext.)': Γ may need to be an extension. This is acknowledged rather than an error.

ideas.what: Encoding a curve over a finitely generated field by an outer Galois representation Γ_K → Out(π̂_1(X)), with an open subgroup of Γ_Q acting
ideas.modern_name: outer Galois representation / anabelian data of a hyperbolic curve
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (1983 letter to Faltings, Esquisse 1984); Ihara, Nakamura, Tamagawa, Mochizuki for results
ideas.where_published: Letter to Faltings (1983); Esquisse d'un programme (1984)

ideas.what: 'Discrétisation/discrétification' of a profinite surface group: choice of the dense discrete topological π_1 inside π̂_1, canonically induced by a complex embedding K̄ → C; Γ acts on such choices, and they form a torsor under the (image of the) discrete Teichmüller modular group
ideas.modern_name: discrete (topological) structure on the étale fundamental group; comparison π_1^top ↪ π_1^et depending on the embedding σ: K̄ → C
ideas.usually_credited_to: Implicit in SGA1 comparison theorem; Galois-conjugate varieties studied by Serre (1964); Teichmüller/GT literature (Ihara, Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura) uses discrete vs profinite mapping class groups
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses discrete vs profinite Teichmüller groups but, to my knowledge, not 'D-structures' explicitly

ideas.what: Mapping class group M_{g,ν} as a subgroup of Aut_ext(π̂_{g,ν}) (injectivity M → Out(π̂))
ideas.modern_name: residual finiteness / injectivity of mapping class group into profinite outer automorphisms
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grossman (1974); later Boggi, Asada (congruence subgroup problem)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (Teichmüller tower, discrete vs profinite)

missed.claim: Grothendieck proposes to package a 'complex embedding of Q̄' purely group-theoretically. It becomes a Γ-equivariant system of discretizations of the profinite surface groups π̂_{g,ν} (a 'D-structure on K̄'), with special D-structures conjectured to be all Γ-conjugate. This amounts to recovering embeddings K̄ → C, up to Galois action, from discrete Teichmüller data. As far as I know it has not been developed systematically in the literature.
missed.quote: Il suffit de plus de donner une discrétisation des π_{X,x}, stable par l'action de Γ, i.e. un [ensemble] de discrétisations formant un torseur sous M'_{g,ν} ⊂ Aut_ext(π̂_{g,ν})
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It relates to how the Galois image in Out(π̂_{g,ν}) (or in GT) sits relative to the discrete mapping class group. It also relates to characterizing complex embeddings / the archimedean place anabelianly. Both are live topics (Galois–Teichmüller theory, anabelian reconstruction of fields), but the 'D-structure' formalism itself seems unrecorded.

deep.surprise_reason: The general framework (outer Galois actions on π̂_{g,ν}, discrete vs profinite Teichmüller groups) is known from Esquisse and the letter to Faltings. The specific notion of a Γ-stable system of 'discretizations' (D-structures), induced by complex embeddings and forming torsors under the modular group, is a notable unpublished formalization. It is only sketched here, without results.
transcription_corrections: '(d'un {+(ou ext.)+} [?]' should read '(d'un Γ = Γ_{K̄/K} ouvert {+(ou ext.)+} dans Γ_{Q̄/Q} ≃ Γ_{Q̃/Q}}' — the inserted words above the line are '(ou ext.)'.
'le cas [?] π_{X,n})' should read 'le cas π_{X,x})' — subscript is x (the base point), not n.
'une {+c+}illustration [?] des π_{X,n}' is almost certainly 'une discrétisation des π_{X,x}' (consistent with 'discrétisations' two lines below and 'discrétification' on the next page).
'i.e. un sujet [?]' is probably 'i.e. un ensemble [?]' or 'un système' (uncertain).
'Cela donne donc [?] les mêmes [?]' is uncertain; the sense is 'Cela donne donc lieu aux/les torseurs sous M'_{g,ν}'.
